faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 2.0 Ingenium diesel in the Land Rover Discovery Sport. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can an Evoque Ingenium engine fit my Discovery Sport?
faqs.a: Sometimes, but only after checks. Both use transverse installations, yet outputs, ancillaries, emissions equipment and calibration can differ, so we compare your VIN and engine code with any replacement before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Ingenium engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery Sport 2.0 diesel engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery Sport 204DTA engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a DPF, turbo or clutch, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204DTA engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Discovery Sport engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their vehicle to us.

faqs.q: How long does a Discovery Sport engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 204DTA?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery Sport decide the best approach. DPF, EGR, AdBlue and turbo faults can often be repaired on their own. If chain failure has damaged the valves or oil dilution has worn the bearings, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTA engine replacement is usually more practical.
paragraphs: A replacement engine needs healthy supporting systems to last. Where relevant, we inspect the DPF, EGR valve and cooler, turbo, intercooler, AdBlue components and cooling system, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery Sport Ingenium Faults
engineProblems.description: The 2.0 Ingenium diesel often shows warning signs early, so prompt checks can prevent major engine damage.

cards.title: Timing Chain Elongation
cards.description: A rattle when starting, camshaft correlation codes or rough running may indicate an elongated timing chain or worn tensioner at the rear of the engine. We measure chain stretch and check timing.

cards.title: Oil Level Rising Between Services
cards.description: An oil level that climbs between services may indicate diesel entering the sump during repeated or interrupted DPF regeneration attempts. We check oil condition and regeneration history.

cards.title: DPF Regeneration Struggles
cards.description: DPF warning lights, reduced power or frequent fan running after shutdown may follow short journeys or sensor faults that stop the filter clearing. We read soot data and assess the DPF.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: EGR Valve Carbon Clogging
cards.description: Hesitation, rough idle, smoke or EGR fault codes can be caused by carbon build-up in the EGR valve or a leaking EGR cooler. We test EGR operation and inspect the cooler.

cards.title: Turbo Boost Pressure Faults
cards.description: Limp mode, flat spots or boost-related fault codes may come from turbocharger wear, a sticking actuator or split intake and intercooler hoses. We test boost control and turbo condition.

cards.title: SCR and AdBlue Faults
cards.description: On later models, AdBlue warnings, emissions faults or a restart countdown may come from a failing NOx sensor, heater, pump or AdBlue injector. We read fault codes and test the system.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTA Engine: Your Complete Ingenium Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTA engine is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder Ingenium diesel used in TD4, SD4 and eD4 versions of the Discovery Sport. Popular for its economy, it is now reaching higher mileages, and timing chain stretch, oil dilution, DPF and EGR problems often lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

The Discovery Sport Ingenium engine is mounted transversely, and outputs, turbo arrangements and emissions equipment vary between versions and model years. We identify the correct Discovery Sport 2.0 diesel engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery Sport 204DTA engine replacement, our team assesses the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
